user.title: Connect to Browser Daemon
user.description: Enter the URL of your browser-daemon instance. A cluster secret or token is optional if the dashboard can issue one automatically.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: The URL of the browser-daemon node and its cluster secret. A blank secret keeps the saved one. The cluster secret is needed for runs (`POST /api/run`), which other integrations such as HR WORKS use.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the browser-daemon instance. Check the URL and network connection.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Provide a valid cluster secret.

abort.already_configured: This Browser Daemon node is already configured.

create_session.name: Create Session
create_session.description: Launch a new browser session on the mesh.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name of saved profile to load (e.g., hrworks, work).

name.name: Session Name
name.description: Optional human-readable label for the session.

idle_timeout_minutes.name: Idle Timeout
idle_timeout_minutes.description: Inactivity timeout in minutes before stopping.

default_tabs.name: Open Default Tabs
default_tabs.description: Open default tabs configured for the profile.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: UUID of the session to terminate.

node.name: Node
node.description: Node where the session is running.

open_tab.name: Open Tab
open_tab.description: Open a new tab in the browser.

url.name: URL
url.description: Web page URL to navigate to.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Optional UUID of the session that should receive the new tab.

close_tab.name: Close Tab
close_tab.description: Close an open tab by ID.

export_auth.name: Export Auth
export_auth.description: Export cookies and localStorage state (Playwright storageState format) for a page or session.

page_id.name: Page ID
page_id.description: Page ID to export auth from.

take_screenshot.name: Take Screenshot
take_screenshot.description: Capture a live JPEG screenshot of a session.

clear_profile.name: Clear Profile
clear_profile.description: Reset cookies and stored state for a named profile.

vacuum_recordings.name: Vacuum Recordings
vacuum_recordings.description: Clean up expired session recordings across the node/mesh.

run.name: Run
run.description: Run a Playwright script or a list of steps in a browser of the mesh and return the result (see docs/run.md of browser-daemon). Needs the cluster secret in the integration.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Run in this profile's browser (on whichever node has it).

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Run in this running session instead.

url.name: URL
url.description: Address to open before the script or steps.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Actions run in order, e.g. [{"action": "click", "selector": "text=Sign in"}, {"action": "text", "selector": "h1", "as": "title"}]. Values of steps with `as` end up in the result.

script.name: Script
script.description: A JavaScript function expression, `async ({ page, context, args, log }) => value`, instead of steps.

args.name: Arguments
args.description: Values for the script (`args`) and the steps (`value_arg`); never logged.

tab.name: Tab
tab.description: A tab (page ID) of the session to run in; by default a new tab, closed afterwards.

keep_open.name: Keep Tab Open
keep_open.description: Leave the run's tab open; its ID is returned as `page`.

persistent.name: Keep Session
persistent.description: A session the run starts stays when the run ends (until its idle timeout).

screenshot_on_error.name: Screenshot on Error
screenshot_on_error.description: Return a screenshot (base64 PNG) of the tab when the run fails.

fail_on_error.name: Fail on Error
fail_on_error.description: Make the action fail when the run fails; otherwise the answer has `ok` false.

idle_timeout_minutes.name: Idle Timeout
idle_timeout_minutes.description: For a session the run starts, minutes without use before it stops.

node.name: Node
node.description: Send the run to this mesh node.

set_idle_timeout.name: Set Idle Timeout
set_idle_timeout.description: Change the idle timeout for an active browser session. Use 0 to disable it.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: UUID of the session to update.

idle_timeout_minutes.name: Idle Timeout
idle_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes before stopping. Use 0 for no timeout.

node.name: Node
node.description: Node where the session is running.

login.name: Log In
login.description: Log in to a Chromium session. Credentials may appear in Home Assistant traces, including values from !secret.

tab.name: Tab ID
tab.description: Chromium page ID in the session.

username.name: Username
username.description: Username to enter in the login form.

password.name: Password
password.description: Password to enter in the login form.

totp_secret.name: TOTP Secret
totp_secret.description: Optional Base32 TOTP seed; do not use with a TOTP code.

totp_code.name: TOTP Code
totp_code.description: Optional 6 to 8 digit TOTP code; do not use with a TOTP secret.

success_selector.name: Success Selector
success_selector.description: Visible element that proves login succeeded.

timeout_seconds.name: Timeout
timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for login results.
